# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Follow the repository-wide guidance in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) for all work in this project.

## Environment File Restriction

Do not access, open, read, search, inspect, or print the contents of `.env.dev`, `.env.local`, `.env.stage`, `.env.test`, or `.env.prod` for any reason. The only environment file that may be accessed is `.env.example`. Use `.env.example` alone when configuration details are needed.

## Project Context

This project describes a Simple Bank fund-transfer feature. For related work, follow `docs/requirement-fund-transfer.md` and `README.md`.
